visual_findings.readability: PASS. Lithuanian headings, paragraphs, captions, links and footer readable at each native viewport; words remain intact. The main heading wraps to three lines at 320 and two lines at larger widths without clipping.
visual_findings.images: PASS. Hero and three category photos load, preserve natural proportions and retain complete principal furniture subjects. Original catalog watermarks remain visible.
visual_findings.ordering_and_association: PASS. Desktop normal places each photo beside its own copy and CTA. All mobile views and desktop stripped place each photo directly before its corresponding copy and CTA.
visual_findings.spacing: PASS. Consistent inner margins, section rules and vertical spacing. No oversized empty columns or dislocated card content. Desktop stripped uses a legible full width stacked layout.
visual_findings.ctas: PASS for visual clarity. Category links remain distinct and associated with the correct photo. The final light CTA button is clear and unclipped. Click targets and href behavior are a separate automated check.
visual_findings.copy: PASS. Visible Lithuanian spelling and diacritics are intact. No dash punctuation observed in customer text. No discount or artificial expiry appears.
